message: 口に出せない、出してくれない

name: Synn
message: 「Are you okay? Not enough sleep again?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yep. It's for the Holy Night Festival surprise!」

name: Synn
message: 「...I see.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm juggling special training, that pest's bubuzuke-style assignments, and Student Council duties, all on top of that. Of course I'm gonna be sleep-deprived.」
Is that really all it is? I wondered, though for some reason I couldn't bring myself to say it out loud.

name: Synn
message: 「Then once the Holy Night Festival is over, I won't have to see that sleep-deprived face anymore.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Right, right! I'll power through until then with the energy of youth!」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, you really should get a little more sleep--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's fine, I'll just sleep during class.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's no good!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So you're saying my health isn't more important than class, Synn?」

name: Synn
message: 「I didn't say that.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's precisely because I'm healthy that I can even take classes. In other words, health comes first!」

name: Synn
message: 「...Keep it in moderation, okay?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Leave it to me. I'm a pro at dozing off, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Yeah, being a pro at that is a little...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahaha.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「...What?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What if I... well... all of a sudden...」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah.」
Even though it was winter, my palms began to grow clammy with sweat.
Nanaka's breathing echoed strangely clearly in my ears.
I avert my gaze from her lips, which look as though she's hesitating over something.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Would you be happy if my boobs got big like Ria-senpai's?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huhhh?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I said, if my boobs got big like Ria-senpai's!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, say something! You boob-lover!」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... I've never really thought about anything like that, so」

name: Synn
message: 「But no matter what happens, I'm sure Nanaka will still be Nanaka to me」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Does that mean... nothing will change no matter what?」

name: Synn
message: 「B-besides, Eddy's the one who loves boobs!」

name: Paqy
message: 「All guys love boobs, man」

name: Paqy
message: 「However! Sadly enough, soba! If they aren't attached to Ria-chan, their value is cut in half」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shut up!」
Nanaka was about to say something just now. There's no mistake.
What was she about to say, I wonder? Still, I can't ask.
Words she deliberately swallowed down. Asking about words she can't even tell me.
Am I scared.

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, right. What was yesterday's talk about?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Th-that. I told you, it wasn't anything big」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... Well, if you say so, then it's fine」
Wasn't it about not being able to transform?
I want to ask, but... I can't.
Nanaka is definitely bothered by it.
By the fact that she's the only one who ends up unable to transform.
On top of that, Nanaka thinks
that when Melilot-san mentioned being short a member, she was referring to her.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's with the sudden seriousness」

name: Synn
message: 「If there's anything I can do, just tell me」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then... maybe I'll ask you for one favor」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, whatever you want」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Really? That's a pretty bold promise」

name: Synn
message: 「You wouldn't ask for anything impossible, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't ask me anything until the Holy Night Festival is over」
